<thought>Combine the resistor dictionaries from the four subnetworks, giving each resistor a unique identifier by prefixing it with its subnet number. Then concatenate all connection lists, updating the resistor IDs to match the new identifiers. Subnet 3 provides a single resistor of 5 Ω, which is added as “S3_R1”. The resulting JSON describes the full network topology.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"S1_R1":2.222,"S1_R2":4.445,"S2_R1":5.0,"S2_R2":8.889,"S2_R3":4.444,"S3_R1":5.0,"S4_R1":20.0,"S4_R2":15.0,"S4_R3":10.0,"S4_R4":5.0},"connections":[["A","N1","S1_R1"],["N1","X1","S1_R2"],["X1","N_b1","S2_R1"],["N_b1","M","S2_R2"],["M","X2","S2_R3"],["B","N_d3","S4_R1"],["N_d3","N_d2","S4_R2"],["N_d2","N_d1","S4_R3"],["N_d1","X3","S4_R4"]]}</final_answer>
